question: What would be printed if braces { } were put around the two indented lines? Explain without tracing the new code line by line.
answer: Then the println is in the body and runs on every pass, after the i++ and before the update. The passes do not change (the test still sees 1 and then 3), so it prints 2 and 4 inside the loop, and the last println still prints 5.
